description: This Java source file defines an interface 'SseRouteBuilder' for building server-sent events (SSE) routes using Akka HTTP. It includes method signatures for configuring authorization, event sniffer, supervision, signal enrichment, proxy actor, and a build method for creating the route.

classes.name: SseRouteBuilder
classes.description: An interface providing a fluent API for constructing Akka HTTP routes for Server Sent Events (SSE). Methods allow configuration of authorization, sniffer, supervision, signal enrichment, proxy actor, and route creation.

methods.name: withAuthorizationEnforcer
methods.description: Sets the authorization enforcer to enforce authorization over the SSE connection. Returns the builder instance for chaining.

methods.name: withEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer used during SSE interactions. Returns the builder instance for chaining.

methods.name: withSseConnectionSupervisor
methods.description: Sets the supervisor for SSE connections. Returns the builder instance for chaining.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider for signal enrichment; if null or unset, streaming requests with 'extraFields' result in an error. Returns the builder.

methods.name: withProxyActor
methods.description: Sets the proxy actor for streaming search results. Returns the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns the Akka HTTP route for SSE, given a request context and a supplier for Ditto headers. Throws NullPointerException if arguments are null.
